en.quote: And ye shall know that I have sent this commandment unto you, that My covenant might be with Levi, saith the LORD of hosts.
en.riddle: that My covenant might be with Levi
en.speaker: the LORD of hosts

he.quote: וִֽידַעְתֶּם כִּי שִׁלַּחְתִּי אֲלֵיכֶם אֵת הַמִּצְוָה הַזֹּאת לִהְיוֹת בְּרִיתִי אֶת-לֵוִי אָמַר יְהוָה צְבָאֽוֹת
he.speaker: אֲדֹנָי צְבָאוֹת

en.quote: Yet ye say, Wherefore? Because the LORD hath been witness between thee and the wife of thy youth, against whom thou hast dealt treacherously: yet is she thy companion, and the wife of thy covenant.
en.riddle: though she is thy companion, and the wife of thy covenant.
en.speaker: the LORD

he.quote: וַאֲמַרְתֶּם עַל-מָה עַל כִּי-יְהוָה הֵעִיד בֵּינְךָ וּבֵין אֵשֶׁת נְעוּרֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר אַתָּה בָּגַדְתָּה בָּהּ וְהִיא חֲבֶרְתְּךָ, וְאֵשֶׁת בְּרִיתֶךָ
he.speaker: אֲדֹנָי
